text: Ha! You ate a pawn. I eat your rook.
The queen is daydreaming on the rim.
NOOOO. That was my WHOLE QUEEN!
Take the queen. A pawn is a crumb.
Psst. Free pawn on h5. Grab it. Nobody's looking.
You ate one snack. I ate the whole queen.
Rook takes horse. Thanks for lunch.
One horse. Two throats.
Two heads?! That's cheating!
One jump bites king and rook.
That pawn on d6 is begging to be eaten.
One jump bites the king and the rook.
Nothing happened. Boring. My favorite.
The smallest soldier wants two trophies.
A PAWN did that?!
Your smallest pawn checks him and eats the rook.
Careful, careful. Just move your king somewhere safe.
A tiny pawn checks the king and bites the rook.
Pawn takes queen. Best trade ever. For me.
Two lunches. One is poison.
You COUNTED? Who taught you that?
Count the guards. Take the one nobody defends.
The bishop is right in the middle. Queen takes bishop!
Count defenders. The bishop is guarded, the knight is free.
Pawn takes queen. You paid a queen for a horse.
Glue the knight to its king.
Glued?! Unglue it! UNGLUE IT!
Pin the knight. It is glued to its king.
Queen takes knight. Big and loud. Do it.
Line the bishop up. The knight is glued to its king.
Pawn takes bishop. Even trade. You got nothing.
It cannot run. Do not cash it. Pile on.
You piled ON?! That's not fair!
It cannot run. Hit it again.
Bishop takes knight! Cash it in now!
The knight cannot move. Attack it again and it dies.
Slow and safe. And nothing.
Stab through the king.
Through the KING?! That's a shish kebab!
Check him. The rook behind him dies.
Rook to h7 wins a pawn next move. Slow and safe.
Check. He steps aside. The rook behind him dies.
You went pawn hunting. The game goes on. And on.
His own pawns locked the door.
MY OWN PAWNS locked the door?!
Mate beats a pawn hunt.
That h5 pawn is free. Go get it.
Mate beats a pawn hunt.
You took the queen. I'm still alive. Rude.
Her queen looks delicious.
Mate?! I was offering you a QUEEN!
Mate ends it. Her queen can wait.
A WHOLE QUEEN. Free. Take it take it take it.
Taking their queen feels huge. Mating them ends the movie.
King takes knight. You gave me a horse for a pawn.
The rook is hiding behind the horse.
A LASER?! Behind the HORSE?!
Move the knight. The rook fires through it.
Knight takes f7 with check! Pawn AND check!
The knight steps aside. The rook becomes a laser. Take the queen with check.
Rook takes horse. Cookie was a trap.
A pawn snack. Or two crowns.
CROWNS?! You skipped the cookie?!
Two crowns beat one cookie.
Pawn on a7. Free cookie. Eat it.
Two royal heads beat one snack pawn.
My bishop sits on the corner forever. Nothing happens.
His bishop guards the corner. Yours guards nothing.
You swapped your WORST piece for my BEST one?!
Swap your dud bishop for his good one.
Keep your bishop! Bishops are precious! Tuck it away!
Trade your useless bishop for the one doing all his work.
Pawns traded, bishops equal. Nothing happened. Perfect.
His bishop cannot see that side of the board.
My bishop is the WRONG COLOUR?! Since when?!
Keep yours. Eat what his cannot guard.
Push a pawn! Pawns win endings! Push! Push!
Keep your bishop. Eat what his cannot guard.
You hid. I kept my bishop. Same as always.
He hits your rook. Hit his king instead.
CHECK?! You were supposed to be SCARED!
Do not run. Check him first.
Your rook! Move it! Tuck it away somewhere safe!
Check first. The checking piece grabs the bishop next.
You ran. My horse is fine. Thanks for playing.
His pawn shoved your rook. See what it dropped.
My pawn was GUARDING that?! Nobody told me!
His pawn stopped guarding. Take the horse.
Your rook is attacked! Run! Run home! Hurry!
The pawn stopped guarding his horse. Take the horse.
Air does not stop a queen. Mate. Bye.
Two pieces on one line, aimed at your king.
The HORSE?! I wanted your QUEEN in the way!
Block with the horse, not the queen.
Give your king some air! A little pawn step!
Block the line with the horse, not the queen.
Bishop eaten, and mate next. Two presents!
Queen and bishop both point at the same square.
Your horse defends AND attacks?! That is cheating!
The horse guards and chases at once.
Block with your bishop! Bishops block! That is their job!
One horse move guards the square and chases the queen.
No legal moves! Stalemate! It's a DRAW! Hahaha!
One move ends it. One move throws it away.
Mate on the back row?! I wanted a draw!
Mate on the back row. The other move draws.
Bring the queen closer. Squeeze him. Squeeze!
Mate on the back row. The other queen move leaves him no legal move at all — a draw.
You checked. I moved. We can do this all day.
One rook holds the row below. The other climbs.
A LADDER?! Who taught you the ladder?!
Second rook mates. The first guards the escape.
Check him! Rook to h7! Checks are exciting!
The second rook lands on the last row. The first one guards the escape.
Pawn takes rook. And now I get a QUEEN. Thank you!
His pawn is one step from a crown.
You just... ate it? With the KING?!
Take the pawn. Checking loses your rook.
Check with the rook! Drive him off! Go go go!
Take the pawn with the king. The check lets the pawn eat your rook and promote.
My king sits right in front. Draw. Nothing you can do.
One king step wins. Pushing the pawn draws.
The KING went first?! That's not how pawns work!
King first. The pawn can wait.
PUSH IT! Pawns want to run! Push the pawn!
Take the square in front of the pawn first. Pushing early lets his king sit in front and hold the draw.
Your horse is gone for one pawn. Delicious.
The pawns are locked. Horses love locked boards.
You left me the bishop ON PURPOSE?! Rude!
Locked board. Keep the horse, give the bishop.
Free pawn in the middle! Jump on it! Yum!
Trade your bishop for his horse. He keeps the bad one.
You retreated. I fixed everything. Boring is good.
Open board. Bishops run. Horses plod.
You traded HORSES?! I wanted your bishop!
Open board. Trade horses and keep the bishop.
Your horse is kicked! Hop it back home! Safe!
Swap horses and keep the bishop. It wins a pawn.
Queen takes f2. That's mate. Thanks!
His queen is staring at your weakest pawn.
Blocked?! By a PAWN?!
One pawn step. Her queen is blocked.
Just develop a knight. Nothing bad ever happens.
One pawn step blocks the queen and saves f2.
You retreated. My board, my rules.
He pushed a pawn at your queen. Look again.
My ROOK too?! That pawn move was a MISTAKE?!
Her queen came out early. Punish the loose square.
Your queen is trapped! Run her home to f3.
The pawn step left e5 loose and the rook behind it.
Cope it is. I am up a whole horse.
He took your horse back. Look at his king.
A CHECK? I forgot about the diagonal!
Check first. The loose pawn is still there after.
You lost a horse! Just develop the bishop and cope.
The check comes first and wins the loose pawn behind it.
Even trade. Nothing happened. Lovely.
His horse took the wrong pawn back.
NOT f7! Anything but f7!
Horse eats beside his king. Nowhere to hide.
Just trade bishop for horse on d5. Simple. Even.
The horse eats f7 and the king cannot hide.
Good student. Bad player.
He kept the gambit pawn. Look at his corner.
My rook can't MOVE?! Who designed this?!
Hit the rook in the corner. It is trapped.
Develop the knight like a good little student.
The queen hits the rook and the loose pawns. It cannot be saved.
You checked. I kept the horse. Fair swap.
He just ate a pawn. Count the guards.
You just... took it? No flair at all!
Two guards. Take the horse back.
Check! Bishop takes f7! Checks are always good!
Two of you guard e4. Take the horse back.
What did that move just attack?
Why is he letting you take that?
You beat Glitch.
Critical hit!
Hit!
Knockout!
Prep done. Slow down. Ask the two questions.
Second try. Glitch is sweating.
Rook gone, pawn eaten. Best trade I ever sold.
One attacker is not enough. Bring a friend.
You brought ANOTHER one?! That is not fair!
Do not take yet. Bring another attacker.
Grab that pawn with the rook. Right now. Free food.
Do not cash it in. Add a second attacker.
You ran away. I keep everything. Lovely.
He guards it twice. You hit it three times.
You COUNTED to three?! Nobody counts to three!
Three hit it. Two guard it. Take.
Your horse is attacked! Save it! Step back! Quick!
Three attackers beat two guards. Take it now.
One rook for one pawn. I love your maths.
One rook is a poke. Two is a punch.
TWO rooks?! On MY road?! Who allowed this?!
Two rooks first. Then the pawn falls.
Just take the pawn now! Rooks are for taking!
Bring the second rook down. Then the pawn falls.
